verdict.rationale: The evidence describes architectures that plausibly keep card data out of the integrator's systems: SumUp hosts the Hosted Checkout payment page, the Payment Widget embeds via a single script, the Cloud API completes transactions on a Solo reader, and in offline mode card data is captured and cached securely on the device. None of this is framed in PCI terms, so the scope reduction is only implied. Missing for 10: any explicit PCI DSS scope or SAQ guidance, statements that the readers are PCI-certified (e.g., PCI PTS/P2PE), documentation of the merchant's remaining compliance obligations, and independent corroboration.
